content.text: Waking at night does happen at 8, often in phases tied to school stress, a busier head, or a bedtime that has drifted. If it's every night and lasting, mention it to her doctor. One thing to try tonight is a calm 10-minute wind-down with no screens in the last hour. Add a quick "what's on your mind" chat at the end, so worries get said before the lights go out. If she wakes, walk her back to bed with as little talk and light as you can.
